name: Zip
bio: Flies the little cannon ship in Centipede Tower Defense. Counts centipede legs for fun.

portrait.subject: a cute small alien gunner kid with antennae, a green visor and a tiny cannon on a backpack, smiling, with a friendly cartoon centipede curled around its shoulder

request: Zip here from Centipede Tower Defense! Friends? I have towers AND a spaceship. 🐛
hello: Woo! You're my favourite non-centipede now.
The spiders say hi. Then they try to bite. Ignore them.
about: I'm Zip! I fly the cannon ship and build towers in the mushroom field. The centipedes just keep coming. So do I!
how: Shoot the centipede segments coming down, earn gold, and put towers in the slots. Upgrade them and survive 20 waves!
tips: Shoot the head! A split centipede makes two heads.
Put a slow tower near the top so everything gets more time under fire.
Clear mushrooms near the bottom: centipedes bounce off them toward you.
Boss waves: upgrade instead of building new.
chat: A centipede has about 40 legs. I counted. Twice. I was right twice.
A flea dropped straight down at me today. Rude flea.
The scorpion turned a whole row of mushrooms poisonous. Mushroom crimes.
My towers have names. Gerald is the best one.
nudge: I upgraded Gerald. Come see Gerald!
idle: The centipedes kept going for {ago} without you. I'm tired!

questions.q: What's scarier: the spider or the scorpion?
a: Bold pick. The flea respects you now.

update: Centipede Tower Defense got updated to v{version}! New wave stuff maybe!
